title.rendered: Best cryptocurrency apps for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Cryptocurrency has become an interesting topic of discussion after the increasing prices of Bitcoin and Elon Musk’s tweets. Every person you know is trying to have a hands-on experience with these wallets. Under such circumstances, it becomes essential to have the right guidance before putting your cash in cryptocurrencies.

But what is more important is finding a safe app to deal with the transactions and protect your holdings. Here is a list of the best apps for buying cryptocurrency on iPhone and iPad to help you achieve both, along with tips for choosing the right wallet.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Coinbase: Editor's choice
  • 2. Cash App: Best for small investments
  • 3. Binance: Best crypto diversity app for trading
  • 4. Gemini: Best for security
  • 5. SoFi: Best for cash management
  • 6. Robinhood: Best for newcomers
  • 7. CoinCap: Best for learning crypto
  • 8. Exodus: Best one-stop solution for crypto knowledge
  • 9. Ledger Live: Best for financial freedom
    • Best features of the cryptocurrency app
    • What is the difference between a crypto exchange and a crypto wallet?

1. Coinbase: Editor’s choice

Coinbase is one of the best cryptocurrency apps for iPhone to buy and sell Bitcoin online. A group spread across 32 countries and 56 million users worldwide, operating over a broad spectrum of cryptocurrencies. 

It supports Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Ethereum, Ethereum Classic, Litecoin, and USD coins. All you need is a bank account to operate, and you will be good to go. Indeed, it is that fast and straightforward to operate the app.

Coinbase comes with smart tools to help you gain knowledge to expand your portfolio, including price alerts and automatic buys. 

When it comes to safety, Coinbase is backed up by industry-leading online security. Of course, all this comes with the obvious passcode, multi-stage verification, and bank-level security. Find everything you need to build your crypto portfolio on Coinbase.

My two cents: Coinbase is one of the most secure apps to build your portfolio.

Pros

  • Offline security for added protection
  • Helpful guides
  • User-friendly dashboard

Cons

  • Trouble tracking profit-loss

Price: Free

Download

2. Cash App: Best for small investments

Here comes an app to invest your extra cash. It is safe, fast, and free to use. Instantly send and receive money from friends and family. Not only that, you can also get a completely free virtual debit card in minutes. 

The app is safe to use, protecting all your transactions with a passcode. You can also use your Touch ID or Face ID to safeguard your app’s account. One of the major advantages of using Cash App is that you can start investing from as low as $1, commission-free. Yes, even Bitcoin from $1!

Track the Bitcoin price in real-time, invest at the right entry point, and have them instantly added to your account. As the company calls it, the cash card gives you multiple discounts, which can be accessed across multiple stores, websites, apps, and restaurants. So start saving small and get huge discounts; that is Cash App for you.

My two cents: Perfect for real-time crypto learning with the minimum investments possible.

Pros

  • Instant addition of Bitcoins to your wallet
  • Virtual Debit Cards instantly
  • Additional discounts for stores, cafes, and restaurants

Cons

  • UI could have been better

Price: Free

Download

3. Binance: Best crypto diversity app for trading

Binance stands out as one of the most diverse cryptocurrency trading platforms. With more than 300 cryptocurrencies to choose from, Binance ensures you never leave the app without investing.

The app supports Bitcoins, Ethereum, Chainlink, Cardano, Binance Coin, and more. All you need is a debit or credit card linked to your account, and you are good to go.

Did you know that you can earn interest on your crypto purchases? Binance gives you significant returns at up to a 5% rate. Moreover, Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU Funds) protects your crypto and interest, so you need not worry about discretion.

My two cents: Binance lets you swap between crypto within the app.

Pros

  • Earn up to 5% interest
  • SAFU protection
  • Set price alerts with a single tap
  • Send crypto wallets with QR codes

Cons

  • Investigation can take a little while

Price: Free

Download

4. Gemini: Best for security

Gemini offers an elegant, safe, and secure way to deal with cryptocurrencies. The buying process is super easy; all you have to do is add your bank account, and you are good to go.

Gemini is another goldmine for crypto diversity. The assets include bitcoin, bitcoin cash, litecoin, basic attention token, Dai, Zcash, Orchid, Compound, PAX Gold, Balancer, Curve, Decentraland, Kyber Network, Maker, Ren Network, Storj, Synthetix Network, Uma, Uniswap, Gemini dollar, and Yearn.finance; the options are endless.

Gemini has great technical analysis, scheduled recurring buys, set price alerts, and many tools to help you understand the process. With Gemini Earn, you can earn up to 7.4% interest on your cryptocurrency. Technical tools to understand the currency and price alerts never to miss an opportunity.  

My two cents: It is safe, easy to install, and gives you a referral bonus when your friends sign up.

Pros

  • Up to 7.4% interest on your cryptocurrency
  • Diversity in cryptocurrency
  • WatchOS support
  • Set price alerts

Cons

  • Charts can be difficult to read

Price: Free

Download

5. SoFi: Best for cash management

Your one-stop solution to deal in crypto, stocks, and automatic investing. The app stands best for no hidden charges on your transactions, no account minimums, and no commissions. Hence, you cannot call this a crypto trading app; it is a cash management app to cater to your financial needs. 

I admire the app as it lets you trade in bitcoins with the proper knowledge and no commission fees or account management fees. However, since they have no maintenance fees, their rate of interest and fee structure may vary. Hence, you have to be peculiar while trading or investing.

However, I would suggest using the app for long-term investments. So, if you have any free cash and are looking for long-term investments, you need to have the app on your iPhone.

My two cents: Stick to the app even if you have issues installing it; it is worth the wait.

Pros

  • Track your spending and credit score
  • Monitor financial insights, spending breakdowns, and more
  • Automate investing
  • No commissions or hidden charges

Cons

  • The dark mode is unavailable

Price: Free

Download

6. Robinhood: Best for newcomers

Robinhood app lets you deal in crypto, stocks, and funds. It is indeed one of the best crypto apps for newcomers to gain confidence. All of this comes with assured security to keep your investments intact.

With options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Dogecoin, Robinhood covers the major leading cryptocurrencies to help broaden your portfolio.

The app comes with in-built trading tools and helps you understand the basics of the market. In addition, it comes with advanced security to safeguard your portfolio. 

My two cents: The app is safe and comes with WatchOS support.

Pros

  • Apple-watch support
  • Commission-free coaching
  • Analyze real-time data
  • Award-winning UI

Cons

  • Experts will miss detailed analysis

Price: Free

Download

7. CoinCap: Best for learning crypto

Keeping a tab on crypto updates is extremely important. When it comes to trading in crypto, CoinCap is one of the smoothest apps on the market. 

With the app, you can track and anticipate the market prices to trade daily. View the coin’s stats, such as live prices, market cap, and 24-hour volume. Make an Altfolio to analyze the stock in real time and monitor the line value of your holding. 

I admire the app’s sorting options. You can filter the results by name, price, percentage change, trading volume, and supply. The alerts on your Apple Watch work best. 

My two cents: I use the app for its Watch app alerts.

Pros

  • Analyze crypto in real-time
  • Supports Apple Watch
  • Clean and simple UI
  • Buy and sell crypto quickly

Cons

  • The swiping feature may accidentally delete all your data

Price: Free

Download

8. Exodus: Best one-stop solution for crypto knowledge

Exodus is a crypto wallet that lets you sell, receive, and exchange your favorite cryptocurrencies with an interactive UI. Manage your crypto in a beautiful blockchain wallet that lets you be in charge of your wealth. 

Supported cryptocurrencies include Bitcoin, Ethereum, ripple, monero, Bitcoin Cash, litecoin, EOS, Zcash, Lisk, Tezos, Link, Nano, Cosmos, Dogecoin, Ravencoin, Ethereum Classic, Decred, NEO, NEO Gas, Wavesm DigiByte, Stellar, and whatnot.

An experience that comes with world-class design, solid engineering, and 24/7 support. The best part about the app is that you don’t need multiple apps to track your crypto orders. You can achieve everything from a single app. 

My two cents: The app works the best as it has a similar UI across both desktop and mobile versions, making it the best in the market.

Pros

  • Impeccable aesthetics
  • Great UI and UX
  • Multiple cryptocurrencies supported
  • One of the most secure software wallets

Cons

  • High import fees

Price: Free

Download

9. Ledger Live: Best for financial freedom

If there is an app that lets you be in charge of your own money, it has to be Ledger Live. A hardware wallet that comes with an app to assure ownership of your crypto assets. It is an all-in-one app that lets you buy, sell, exchange, grow, and manage your crypto in one place.

The security is beyond par as it lets you have full authority over your assets. When you trade in crypto, what matters is the key that lets you have access to your coins. Ledger has a different approach to it that lets you have direct access to the key and ensures full ownership. 

Ledger also lets you exchange one crypto for another, thereby increasing your possibilities to experience multiple cryptos. Currently, it is dealing in Bitcoin, Ethereum cash, Bitcoin Cash, tether, stellar, and Dash. You can manage 27 coins directly from the app and 1500 different tokens.

My two cents: If a hardware crypto wallet is your thing, this one is the best in the market.

Pros

  • Hardware crypto wallet
  • Diverse crypto portfolio
  • Easy, safe, and secure to use
  • Real-time in-app checking

Cons

  • Lacks in-depth explanation

Price: Free

Download

Above are some of the best cryptocurrency apps for iPhone and iPad you can try. But which one should you narrow down to? Keep scrolling!

Best features of the cryptocurrency app

Here are a few things you should always be considerate about before getting on a crypto app.

  • Real-time data.
  • Security (better if encrypted).
  • Fees and maintenance charges.
  • Exchanging crypto and sharing them with friends and family.
  • The interest rate on crypto purchases.
  • Cryptocurrency diversity.
  • Nature of the wallet: Hardware or software.

Moreover, as a beginner, many people interchangeably use crypto exchange and crypto wallet. But they aren’t the same!

What is the difference between a crypto exchange and a crypto wallet?

The basic difference between a crypto wallet and a crypto exchange is the private key. If you own a crypto wallet, you have complete control over your private key. This increases your crypto purchases’ security because a key is the only way to access them.

On the other hand, the crypto exchange offers trading, selling, and buying cryptocurrencies that lack wallets. Thus, if you are looking for long-term storage of your crypto, go for a wallet. If you are actively trading, look for an exchange.

I hope this guide helped you find the best cryptocurrency app for iPhone and iPad. Which one of these have you used and loved? Let me know in the comments below.

You may also like to read these:

  • Payroll Management iPhone and iPad
  • Best Personal Finance Apps for iPhone and iPad
  • Perfect Student Loan Management App!

title.rendered: Best adventure games for iPhone and iPad in 2026

content.rendered:
Adventure games have always been fun to play. They bring in the right mix of quests, collectibles, stories, and game length. There are a lot of adventure games available now on the App Store, all claiming to bring something new. I’ve tried to make it a bit easier for you through this list of the best adventure games for iPhone. This way, you don’t have to search the App Store for hours to find what you’re looking for. Let’s have a look at the games below.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery – Editor's Choice
  • 2. Garena Free Fire – New Age – Best action-adventure game
  • 3. Best Fiends – Puzzle Adventure – Best puzzle adventure game
  • 4. Coin Master – Best adventure game for kids
  • 5. Hit Master 3D: Knife Assassin – Best offline adventure game
  • 6. Bermuda Adventures: Farm Games – Best simulation adventure game
  • 7. Giant Rush – A casual adventure game
  • 8. Playdead's INSIDE – Best indie adventure game

1. Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery – Editor’s Choice

Fans of Harry Potter are going to love this game. If you’ve craved the definitive Harry Potter game on your iPhone, this is it.

The game is tailored to your gameplay style. You get to choose which house you’re going to join, which alliances to form, which classes to take, and much more. Interact with iconic characters such as Albus Dumbledore and Severus Snape, all while forging your path as a wizard or a witch at Hogwarts.

Believe me when I say that there are almost no limits to what can be done in this game. You can play Quidditch, brew different potions, learn new spells, and go around the unexplored corridors of Hogwarts for new quests and mysteries.

The game does suffer from an issue where your energy runs out rather quickly, just by completing a couple of events. However, this isn’t a game-breaking bug.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

2. Garena Free Fire – New Age – Best action-adventure game

While PUBG Mobile introduced the system of battle royale, multiple other games have taken inspiration and added their twists to the games. Garena Free Fire – New Age is another adventure game with similar battle royale mechanics.

There are 50 competitors, and only 1 can be the last person standing. You are dropped into a remote island and have to search for loot, ammo, and weapons to survive against the other players. Each match is intense and is wrapped up at the 10-minute mark.

The short period of the game makes it highly addictive. Moreover, each location has different hideouts and shooting spots, so you can strategize accordingly. You can also team up with other players online to form a 4-member squad. The game might be similar to PUBG, but it has its charm as well.

Players have complained about the customer service for the game though. So you should be wary before you make any in-game purchases.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

3. Best Fiends – Puzzle Adventure – Best puzzle adventure game

There are a lot of puzzle games for iPhone, but very few puzzle games also add a touch of adventure to the mix. Best Fiends – Puzzle Adventure attempts to enter a very specific niche.

The game is massive, with over 4000 hours of game content. To ensure that you aren’t bored, the game also includes a story. You will have to collect characters as you progress through the game and form a team.

The team can be upgraded as you level up in the game. The better the level of your team, the better your chances are at defeating the Slugs. The Slugs aim to take over the world, and it is your responsibility to stop them.

There are lots of different puzzles to solve in the game. So, for those who are looking for an equal mix of adventure and puzzles, this is a good game to try.

However, a major issue with the game is that it has random difficulty spikes when you’re playing certain levels.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

4. Coin Master – Best adventure game for kids

This is an adventure game that has a bit of everything. From collecting cards to raiding other Viking villages, it’s a good mix for an adventure game.

The objective of the game is to transform your Viking village into the most powerful village. You can spin the in-game wheel to know whether you’ve won loot, extra attack time, or shields.

We need to strategize and build your village, as having a village with lots of loot and a lack of proper shields will result in your village being looted. You can also go on the front foot and raid the other Viking villages.

The game instructs you to collect cards and complete sets, before moving onto different villages. Completing the set will also grant you bonuses. The game’s aesthetic is casual and can be a good iPhone game for kids.

A caveat with the game is that you’ll have to spend on packs to complete the daily activities, especially at the higher levels. The game simply does not provide you with enough material to complete daily objectives.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

5. Hit Master 3D: Knife Assassin – Best offline adventure game

When I first heard the name of this game, I thought I’d be playing a game similar to the Hitman series. To my pleasant surprise, I was wrong. Hit Master 3D: Knife Assassin is one of the most entertaining adventure games you can play.

Similar to spy movies, your character gets caught and ambushed by the enemies. You’ve only got knives to defend yourself. The only way to beat the waves of enemies is to accurately throw knives at them.

There are different parts of the environment that you can use to your advantage, such as a flammable barrel, or a hanging object. You also have to save hostages along the way.

The game has a very casual and cartoonish aesthetics to it, and this offsets the game’s somewhat serious name. Some players have said that the game is too easy, though. So, if you’re looking for a challenge, this game may not be the one for you.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $3.99)

Download

6. Bermuda Adventures: Farm Games – Best simulation adventure game

Bermuda Adventures: Farm Games is a survival adventure game for casual players. It can also fit into the genre of simulation games, considering some of its game elements.

A family is stranded on a desert island after a plane crash, and must now survive the harsh conditions of the island. From finding lost relatives to growing crops for food, its simulation elements are noteworthy.

There are different characters to interact with within the game, and all of them are unique in their personality traits. You also have to make decisions and choose various paths for multiple characters. Start as a farmer, grow your area, expand to different islands, and become a city manager.

After you’ve leveled up substantially, the game’s tasks may get repetitive. This is one of the issues that this game needs to fix.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

7. Giant Rush – A casual adventure game

This is a simple game. You won’t find any fancy gameplay mechanics or beautiful graphics in this game. Despite this, Giant Rush is an enjoyable game.

The gameplay is simple. You have to run through obstacles, collect as many soldiers as you can to defeat the enemy’s army, and fight the Giant at the end.

Keep in mind that if the number of soldiers that you have in your army is less than the number of soldiers in the enemy army, you will fail and have to restart from the very beginning.

While the game’s simplicity is one of its selling points, it can also get repetitive.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

8. Playdead’s INSIDE – Best indie adventure game

I’ve played INSIDE on my personal computer, and I’ve been floored by the game. It’s simply one of the best adventure games that I’ve ever played. Now, this amazing game is available on mobile devices as well.

The game’s design is brilliant. You control a boy who has lost his way and found himself at the center of a project that has the potential to be world-changing, but not for the better.

You will have to get to the heart of this project and stop it. But before that, you must solve numerous puzzles and avoid enemies. There’s enough variety here to keep you hooked through the entire playthrough. You will have to pay for the full game, however.

The art design, visuals, and audio, everything comes together to form a spectacular game that can influence similar games in the future.

The game does not hold your hand for the puzzle sequences, though, and this might get frustrating for a small percentage of players.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $6.99)

Download

Ready to go on an adventure?

Adventure games are always fun to play due to the sheer variety that they bring to the table. I’ve tried my best to cover the different adventure games, for people with specific tastes. Did you like this list of the best adventure games for iPhone? Share your thoughts in the comments section.

title.rendered: How to turn a video or a GIF into a Live Photo on iPhone

content.rendered:
Have a special video you want to convert into a Live Photo to rewatch a single section again and again or set it as live wallpaper on your Home Screen? No worries, this article will help you crack the code and turn a video into a Live Photo. So, let’s get started without any delay.

  • How to make videos or GIFs into Live Photos on iPhone
  • How to set Live Photos as wallpaper on iPhone and iPad
  • Best iOS apps to turn video or GIF into Live Photo

How to make videos or GIFs into Live Photos on iPhone

Apple offers some preset to convert a Live Photo into a video. However, it does not do so for the reverse situation. And we’ll have to rely on third-party apps to convert videos to Live Photos on iPhone and iPad.

For now, I am using the intoLive app to illustrate the process. You can choose any other app of your choice. I have lined up some of the best Live Photo creating apps in the last section.

  1. Launch intoLive app, find and select the video.
  2. Here, use the slider to choose the video section to convert.
    If needed, edit the video, add filters, select the cover photo, etc. The editing options will vary from app to app.
  3. Tap Make/Convert to create the Live Photo.
  4. Tap Save Live Photo to download it.

And just like that, your Live Photo is ready. It is stored in All Photos and the Live Photos album on your iPhone or iPad. You can edit it, add filters, and more as you do with other Live Photos.

How to set Live Photos as wallpaper on iPhone and iPad

  1. Launch Photos → Albums tab.
  2. Scroll down and select Live Photos album.
  3. Select the Live Photo you want to set as wallpaper.
  4. Tap the Share icon.
  5. Scroll down and tap Use as Wallpaper.

  6. Here, ensure the Live icon is on and pinch in/out to adjust the image,
  7. Tap Set and select Set Lock Screen.

Note: If you want the Live Photo as Home Screen wallpaper, tap Set Both. However, the Home Screen wallpaper doesn’t animate; you’ll only be able to see the cover image of the Live Photo here.

Best iOS apps to turn video or GIF into Live Photo

  1. intoLive
  2. VideoToLive
  3. Giphy

1. intoLive – The all-in-one app

As you can see from the above tutorial, intoLive is a pretty simple-to-use app. However, its strength lies in its versatility. You can convert a video, GIF, burst photos, and even multiple still photos into a Live Photo.

Amazingly, the app also allows you to switch up/down the speed of the video or edit the canvas, i.e., the layout of the Live Photo. And if you go for intoLive Pro, you can even split the screen, add up to 4 photos or videos to one frame, and makeup to 30sec long Live Photo.

Pros

  • Easy-to-use
  • Converts videos, GIFs, stills, and more
  • Can switch Live Photo canvas
  • Pro plan is quite reasonable

Cons

  • Not even a single filter is free
  • Ads on every window

Price: Free (intoLive Pro for $4.99 lifetime)

Download

2. VideoToLive – Create unlimited Live Photos

Want to create a Live Photo without the five-second limit? Or turn video into a Live Photo with sound. No problem, VideoToLive is your jam. Either select a long video or stitch together clips from multiple videos, photos, or existing Live Photos to make a long Live Photo.

Plus, you can even give it background music, either from Apple Music, Files, or videos saved in your iPhone. And while you can’t hear the music, the whole video runs when you long-press this Lock Screen wallpaper.

Interestingly, VideoToLive also doubles as a GIF maker. However, the app randomly quits on you, and irritatingly, you’ll have to start the project all over again.

Pros

  • Create Live Photos without limit
  • Stitch multiple clips together
  • Add music to Live Photos

Cons

  • Quits unexpectedly at times
  • Not beginner-friendly
  • No option for filters, transitions, etc.

Price: Free (Remove ads for $3.99)

Download

3. Giphy – Packed with awesome features

If you are a GIF lover, you’ll probably need no introduction to this app. You might also know that you can create your GIF in the app. But do you know that you can convert GIFs to Live Photos with Giphy?

The scheme also includes Videos. Well, you convert the video into a GIF and then download that GIF as Live Photos. And it might seem like some effort, but you get some amazing filters, an endless array of stickers, add text feature, and more in return.

There are also two other issues. One, you can’t convert to Live Photo unless you upload the GIF, although you can keep it private and delete it asap. Secondly, the quality of the image is almost always compromised.

Pros

  • Easy to use
  • Fun filters
  • Variety of stickers
  • Ready-made gallery of GIF

Cons

  • Lengthy process
  • Quality is compromised

Price: Free

Download

I hope, as promised, you were able to learn how to turn a video into a Live Photo. If you have any further queries or suggestions, feel free to use the comment section below.

Want to tip your toe deeper into the Live Photo pond? These lifesaver jackets, aka articles, might help you out:

  • How to use Boomerang on Instagram using iPhone
  • Best live wallpaper apps for iPhone (Top 10 pick)
  • How to convert Live Photos to still photos on an iPhone

title.rendered: How to find the MAC address on an iPhone or iPad

content.rendered:
Some companies or organizations operate on a close Wi-Fi network. So it’s not uncommon for them to ask their staff for their MAC address. Well, you might be confused about what this strange acronym means. To start, MAC stands for Media Access Control, and it’s unique to every device that supports an internet connection. So, your iPhone has it, too.

Read on to learn more about what a MAC address is and how you can locate yours on your iPhone or iPad.

What’s a MAC Address on iPhone, and why would you need it?

The MAC address on your iPhone or iPad is the unique ID that distinguishes it from the others on a shared network. The network internet controller (NIC) hosts the MAC address on internet-enabled devices. While this chip remains fixed to the motherboard on iPads and iPhones, it’s removable in some older devices.

When you turn on a public router, for instance, it locates all close-by devices using their MAC addresses. Thus, a device without a MAC ID can’t connect to Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi network.

MAC address is often handy when specifying devices that can join a closely shared network. For example, you can configure a router to accept specific MAC IDs. And like usernames, it rejects any MAC ID not stored in its configuration memory.

And that explains why your organization or company might ask you to provide your MAC address. Nonetheless, some people without access still try to fool such a close network through what’s called MAC ID spoofing.

Although there are third-party spoofers for changing a device’s MAC address, this isn’t easily achieved on iOS. That said, starting with iOS 14, Apple now allows you to switch your MAC ID to a private one. It still doesn’t mean you can generate random MAC addresses for your iOS device.

How to see your MAC address on iPhone or iPad

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Go to General.
  3. Tap About.
  4. You’ll see your device’s Wi-Fi MAC address to the right of the Wi-Fi Address.
    The Bluetooth MAC address is also next to Bluetooth.

That’s it! You can now long-press your Mac address and tap Copy to share it with anyone that needs it.

FAQs

Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can’t tweak their values by yourself as they’re built-in to your device.

Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it’s also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad’s MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

Knowing what a MAC address is and how to find it can save you a lot of confusion whenever you need it. And I hope this article solves your problem already.

Are you wondering if someone might track you with your MAC address? Well, it’s not impossible. But we all share it when we connect to public networks. So feel free to share it with whoever needs it. Have more questions? Share them in the comments below.

title.rendered: SD card not working on 14-inch and 16-inch MacBooks? Fixes

content.rendered:
Apple swapped the SD card slot on MacBook Pro with four USB-C ports in 2016. It took flak from users who didn’t like the idea of using a bunch of dongle/adapters with their new MacBook Pro. Years later, Apple has reintroduced SD cards and MagSafe charging on 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro.

Unfortunately, there is a deluge of complaints regarding the SD card on the 2021 MacBook Pro. Many users are experiencing slow transfer speeds. Some users are unable to access memory cards on their MacBook Pro. The erratic nature of the problem has confused users. But we have some fixes. Read on!

  • How to fix SD card reader not working on Mac
    1. Upgrade to the latest macOS version
    2. Enable external discs in Finder Preferences
    3. Unlock SD card
    4. Backup data and format SD card on Mac
    5. Access SD card in Recovery mode on Mac
    6. Try changing the SD card adapter
  • How to fix slow SD card reader on 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro
    1. Check for speeds using an external SD card reader
    2. Clean adapter and card
    3. Change SD card to increase data speeds
    4. Contact Apple support

How to fix SD card reader not working on Mac

Apple has informed users that it is looking into the problem. Till then, we have curated the most effective ways to fix SD cards on MacBook Pro.

1. Upgrade to the latest macOS version

For some users, upgrading to the latest version of macOS did the trick. After upgrading, they could use SD cards without problem on their Mac. If this works, it could be a software bug and not a hardware issue.

The issue was reportedly solved in macOS Monterey 12.1 Beta 4 for some. Hopefully, the update will appear on macOS stable build.

2. Enable external discs in Finder Preferences

Some users report that they are unable to see SD cards in Finder. One of the possibilities is that the external card is hidden in the Finder sidebar. macOS offers many ways to customize Finder toolbars. Follow the steps below to enable the Finder sidebar.

  1. Open Finder.
  2. Click Preferences.
  3. Navigate to the Sidebar option.
  4. Enable External disks from the checkbox menu.

For the sake of convenience, you can create an SD card shortcut on the desktop. Here is how:

  1. Open Finder Preferences.
  2. Navigate to General.
  3. Select External Disks under Show these items on the desktop.

Now, you can access the external disc via a desktop shortcut.

3. Unlock SD card

All SD cards come equipped with a slider lock. If the slider is down, the card is locked. When locked, you will no longer get to access the SD card. Hence, before inserting it into the card slot, ensure it is unlocked.

Furthermore, check whether the disk is encrypted. If so, you will need the encryption key/password to access the content.

4. Backup data and format SD card on Mac

Sometimes you can access the contents of the SD card but are unable to transfer data. In such a scenario, create a backup. Once the backup is successful, go ahead and format the SD card. Users have noted that SD card formatted on other devices like DSLR camera or GoPro is not accessible on MacBook Pro.

You can solve this issue by formatting the SD card. You can check our detailed guide to understand the process. Make sure you choose the appropriate Filesystem format. For SD cards larger than 64GB, format with ExFAT, and for smaller cards, you can choose FAT32.

Once done, insert the card and check it is working on your Mac.

Note: The exFAT format works only on newer macOS (Snow Leopard and above).

5. Access SD card in Recovery mode on Mac

Recovery Mode on Mac is an effective way to diagnose software issues. macOS fires up a diagnostic check of your Mac’s startup disk, deleting cache files if necessary. Here is how you can use Recovery Mode on Mac with an Intel chip. If you use an M1-powered Mac, check out this guide.

Next, exit Safe Mode and check if the SD card is working properly.

6. Try changing the SD card adapter

These days most of us use microSD cards. Mac users commonly use an SD card adapter. Some reports claim that SD card adapters affect performance. It is a grey area. However, I suggest you try out a different adapter and see if it makes any difference.

This should help get your SD card up and running. However, if it’s running slow, read on to learn what you need to do.

How to fix slow SD card reader on 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro

Some 2021 MacBook Pro users complained, saying that they could open and access the SD card but experienced slow transfer speeds. Before proceeding, note that Apple has already confirmed the UHS-II (speeds up to 300MB/s) standard for the SD card slot on MacBook Pro.

One of the most common error messages is “The Finder can’t complete the operation because some data in “filename” can’t be read or written.” The below troubleshooting steps should help you fix this error.

1. Check for speeds using an external SD card reader

Arrange for an external card reader and check for transfer speeds. The majority of MacBook users experienced better speeds with an external card reader. If it is the same case with you, the problem is with macOS or the MacBook Pro hardware.

Once diagnosed, you can reach out to Apple Support and ask for an explanation.

2. Clean adapter and card

It is likely for debris to accumulate on SD card contact points and even inside the adapter. Sometimes debris like lint affects performance and could also prevent SD cards from working.

I suggest using a small brush to clean the dust and other particles. If you use an adapter, blow some air to push the dust out.

3. Change SD card to increase data speeds

SD cards are speed-rated by the manufacturer. Each speed class will tell you about transfer speeds. Choosing a memory card of the right speed class is essential. The SD association mentions Class 2, Class 4, 6, and 10, with Class 10 being the fastest. Ideally, transfer speeds on your SD card should correspond to its Speed Class.

Consider upgrading the SD card to one with a higher speed class if necessary.

4. Contact Apple support

As a last resort, you can contact Apple Support. They will run a series of diagnostics and find the root cause. If in warranty, Apple will repair your MacBook for free. The company might swap your MacBook Pro with a new device in certain cases.

Apple could release a fix for the SD card issue on MacBook Pro. I suggest you wait for some time. Meanwhile, you can use external card readers as a stop-gap arrangement. Still, facing SD card issues on MacBook Pro? Let us know if the steps helped in the comments below.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

title.rendered: Alto iPhone 13 series leather cases review

content.rendered:
Leather cases are my favorite because of their unmatched elegance and durability. But it’s important to go for the right brand offering high-quality materials and craftsmanship. Alto is a go-to option in this regard.

I already loved their AirPods cases and Apple Watch band, so I had to try the phone cases too. Did they meet my expectations? Find out below in my full review of Alto iPhone 13 series leather cases.

Note: All iPhone 13 series cases by Alto are available at a 10% discount between December 13 to 27, 2021.

I’ve reviewed three types of Alto iPhone 13 series cases:

  • Alto Original 360 leather cases
  • Alto Metro leather wallet case
  • Alto Anello 360 leather lanyard case

1. Alto Original 360 leather case

Key features

  • Available for iPhone 13 mini, 13, 13 Pro, and 13 Pro Max 
  • 5ft/1.5m military-grade drop-tested
  • Raised edges for screen and camera protection 
  • Supports wireless charging
  • 3 color options 

Minimalist, protective, durable, and stylish. This elegant leather case ticks all the boxes! Let’s consider some of the vital aspects below.

Design

Alto’s Original 360 leather case is handcrafted from full-grain Italian leather that looks and feels exquisite. It’s ultra-slim and sleek yet provides adequate drop protection. Encased within the leather is a sturdy TPU frame to fortify your phone.

I love how the inside of the case has a soft lining. Plus, there are tactile buttons to cover the original buttons of the phone for an all-around, stylish look. The three color options are super attractive, and I simply can’t pick a favorite. The leather will develop a unique patina over time for a classy vintage look.

What’s more? You can have your name or other words laser-engraved onto the case when you place an order. There’s also gift packaging available which makes this a great and unique Christmas gift for parents or other special people in your life. All in all, Alto scores big on design, and these phone cases are a delight to own and use.

Protection

Design’s all well and good, but the purpose of a phone case is to protect your precious device. I’m happy to report that Alto Original 360 cases offer military-grade drop protection for up to 5ft/1.5m. The combination of shock-proof TPU encased within genuine leather offers sturdy defense against everyday wear and tear.

Further, the inner lining provides cushioning and prevents scratches. At the same time, the subtle raised edges around the screen and camera provide extra safety to the most delicate parts of your iPhone. This case is not a bumper built for extreme adventure, but it offers more than adequate protection for daily use.

User-friendliness

With the carefully picked natural materials, beautiful handcrafted design, and attention to detail, Alto’s slim leather cases are a breeze to use. The buttons are easy to press, and all the ports remain accessible. The case does not interfere with your phone’s functions, and they fit together like they’re made for each other.

Moreover, you can also opt for a MagSafe charging compatible version of this case that’s all the more user-friendly. However, the MagSafe-compatible case is not available for iPhone 13 mini.

Pros

  • Slim and sleek
  • Genuine Italian leather
  • Military-grade drop protection
  • Supports wireless charging
  • Beautiful color options

Cons

  • None

Buy now: iPhone 13 mini | iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro | iPhone 13 Pro Max

2. Alto Metro leather wallet case

Key features

  • Available for iPhone 13, 13 Pro, and 13 Pro Max
  • One card pocket
  • Raised edges for screen and camera protection 
  • Supports wireless charging 

Keep your essential credit/debit card close with this handy wallet case from Alto. Here’s my take on how it fares in different aspects.

Design

This case is designed to make your life more convenient. It features a handy card slot flap at the back to hold a card or two. It comes in three beautiful color options: full Raven Black, a combination of Cement Gray/Original Nude, and Caramel Brown/Raven Black. I received the last option, and it was love at first sight.

I love this case’s flip-style card slot. You can move it out of the way when using wireless charging. However, the one downside is that the leather doesn’t cover the button area. Nonetheless, it’s a sleek, stylish design that’ll serve you well.

Protection

I love the slim profile of this leather wallet case, but unfortunately, it doesn’t offer much drop protection. It does a good job of keeping away scratches and has raised edges around the screen and camera for extra safety. But the phone’s buttons are left exposed.

The card pocket is pretty sturdy and has been tested to last over 10,000 flips, so you need not worry about durability.

User-friendliness

There’s no doubt that Alto’s Metro leather wallet case is pretty user-friendly. It’s super easy to put your card in and out of the slot, and all the functions of your phone are easily accessible. It also supports wireless charging for convenience.

However, I noticed that your card could easily slip out of the slot, which is not ideal. Further, it won’t do much to prevent damage from drops, so it is made for gentle users.

Pros

  • Genuine Italian leather
  • Supports wirelesss charging
  • Slim, sleek, and beautiful
  • Handy card slot
  • Raised edges for screen and camera protection

Cons

  • Not much drop protection
  • Card can easily slip out of the slot

Buy now: iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro | iPhone 13 Pro Max

3. Alto Anello 360 leather lanyard case

Key features:

  • Available for iPhone 13, 13 Pro, and 13 Pro Max 
  • 5ft/1.5m military-grade drop-protection 
  • Comes with a convenient neck strap 
  • Card slot 
  • Raised edges for screen protection 
  • Supports wireless charging

Here’s the most functional Alto leather case with a cardholder and matching neck strap.

Design

Just like Alto’s other cases, this one is designed to perfection. It includes a sleek cardholder at the back, plus a handy lanyard.

The full-grain Italian leather beautifully covers the phone and offers a sleek, lightweight look that stands out from the crowd. It’s available in Cement Gray, Raven Black, and Forest Green colors, each with a unique appeal.

Protection

As for protection, you can use your phone worry-free thanks to 5ft/1.5m military-grade drop protection. The leather wraps snugly around your device, and an inner TPU frame absorbs impacts in case of falls.

Of course, the neck strap makes it much less likely that you’ll drop your phone in the first place. As expected, there are raised edges to keep scratches away and an inner lining for some extra cushioning.

User-friendliness

I’m a big fan of the movable card holder that keeps your cards hidden from view. Moreover, it doesn’t add any bulk and is easy to access.

Further, the case is compatible with wireless charging for everyday convenience. Add in the matching lanyard, and you have a complete package that’s perfect for a busy lifestyle.

Pros

  • Handcrafted from Italian leather
  • Military-grade drop protection
  • Supports wirelesss charging
  • Cardholder
  • Matching lanyard
  • Raised edges for screen and camera protection

Cons

  • A bit pricey

Price: $79.95

Buy now: iPhone 13 mini | iPhone 13 | iPhone 13 Pro | iPhone 13 Pro Max

Verdict: Alto cases are excellent for everyday use

On the whole, Alto’s cases score big on quality and design. They make the perfect everyday companion for your iPhone and will last a long time. It could also be a thoughtful gift for a fellow iPhone user. They’re super simple to use and look effortlessly stylish.

Go for the Alto Original leather case for a minimalist look that’s still highly protective. Or get the Alto Metro leather wallet case if you like to card wherever you go. Finally, if you prefer going hands-free when out and about, get the Alto Anello 360 lanyard case that’s a breeze to carry around.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

title.rendered: How to recover deleted messages in Messenger on iPhone or web

content.rendered:
It can be frustrating when you can’t find important messages or chats on Facebook. You might’ve even concluded that you’ve deleted them already. However, Facebook has a reputation for keeping memories (read data). Hence, there are ways to recover deleted messages on Facebook and Messenger using iPhone and the web.

Read this article to find out those tricks and retrieve your messages!

Check archived messages on Facebook and Messenger

If you can’t find a chat or message, you might’ve archived it instead of deleting the chat permanently. Similar to finding archived posts on Instagram, you can retrieve archived messages on Facebook Messenger. Your lost messages might just be there.

Here’s how to do it:

See archived chat on the Messenger app using iPhone

  1. Open the Facebook Messenger app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap the three-horizontal line icon at the top right corner.
  3. Select Archive.
  4. Long-tap the chat or message you want to retrieve and choose Unarchive.

Find archived chat on the Facebook website

On the web, log in to your Facebook account and follow these steps:

  1. Click the dotted square icon at the top right (next to your name).
  2. Scroll down and select Messenger in-app.

  3. Click the three-dotted horizontal icon at the top of the Chats menu.
  4. Select Archived chats.

  5. Click the three-dotted icon to the right of a conversation you want to retrieve and select Unarchive chat.

However, if you can’t find your chats in the archived messages, they may be gone forever. But there’s one more hopw!

Downloading your chat data from Facebook may help you to recover deleted messages. Before deleting your messages from the server, Facebook saves the data for a certain period. Hence, you may find your deleted messages in the Facebook data if you are on time.

How it works? Well, once requested, you’ll get a zipped file containing your chat history with each of your Facebook friends.

How to download Facebook data on iPhone

  1. Open the Facebook app.
  2. Tap the small picture icon at the bottom right.
  3. Scroll down and tap Settings & Privacy.
  4. Select Privacy shortcuts.
  5. Scroll down, and select Access your information under Your Facebook information.
  6. Swipe to the bottom and tap Download your information.

  7. Choose Deselect All → select Messages.
  8. Scroll to the bottom and tap the dropdown under Date range to choose a date range.
  9. Select CREATE FILE.

  10. On the next screen, you’ll see a message for your requested file that says Pending.
    Wait for a few minutes, and Facebook will notify you in the notification menu when your data is ready for download.
  11. Once your download is ready, tap Download.
  12. Enter your Facebook password and select Continue to download.

  13. If Safari is your default browser, tap the AA symbol at the top left.
    If you’re using Chrome instead, tap the three horizontal dots at the bottom-right:
    • Select Downloads.
    • Pick the downloaded file from the list.
    • Tap it to unzip and view its content.

How to download Facebook data on the Facebook website

  1. Click the Account icon at the top right.
  2. Select Settings & privacy.

  3. Click Privacy shortcuts.

  4. Under Your Facebook information, select Access your information.

  5. Scroll to the bottom and click Download your information.

  6. Select a date range from the Date range field.

  7. Click Deselect and choose Messages.

  8. Scroll to the bottom and click Request a download.

Facebook will notify you as soon as your information is ready. You can also click Available files at the top of that menu. Next, click Download to the right of the requested file to get it on your computer.

Note: If you deleted messages and can’t find them in the downloaded data, you can get a copy of these chats from your friends if they’ve not deleted it from their end. A recommended way is to tell them as soon as possible to follow the steps for downloading their Facebook message data as explained.

So, that’s how you can access removed messages on Messenger or Facebook! However, many people told me that many third-party apps promised to recover permanently deleted Facebook messages on iPhone. But is it really true and safe? Find out!

Can you download Facebook messages via third-party apps?

Well, when you delete a message on Facebook, it is permanently removed. While some third-party apps might claim to help download your Facebook data, this isn’t true and can be a portal to a privacy breach. So be careful what apps you grant access to your Facebook history.

As said earlier, using the Facebook app method itself works better and is secure than any other third-party option.

Besides, deleted or wiped chats might become unretrievable on Facebook as these aren’t on Facebook’s server anymore. So, don’t fall for third-party apps making such commitments!

That’s it!

This is how you can get back a deleted Facebook message on your iPhone and the web. Have more questions? Share them in the comment section below.

  • How to hide likes and views on your Instagram posts
  • Send Soundmojis on Facebook Messenger

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

title.rendered: How to change the default email account on iPhone

content.rendered:
The first email you add to the iPhone Mail app becomes your default. This means that when you compose a new email or click on an email address on a website or app, it opens with this default email in the ‘From’ section.

It’s no secret that we have multiple emails, but we use one for most communications. Thus, for ease, you may like to set this one as the default. To help, let me show you a quick way to change the default email account on your iPhone or iPad, along with the steps to switch, disable, and delete it.

Note: This is different than changing the default email app on iPhone.

  • How to set default email on iPhone and iPad
  • How to switch email accounts on iPhone and iPad
  • Disable an email account on iOS device
  • Delete or remove an email account on iPhone and iPad

How to set default email on iPhone

Before you begin, make sure you have added multiple (at least two) emails to the Mail app. Now, follow the below steps to change the default email.

  1. Open Settings and tap Mail.
  2. Tap Default Account at the bottom.
  3. Choose the desired email account to set it as the default.

To check: Tap the following email info@igeeksblog.com. The ‘compose a new message’ screen will open with the default email (you set in step 3) under the ‘From:‘ section.

How to switch email accounts on iPhone and iPad

Setting the default email will help you use the one by default when you start composing a new email. But what if, at times, you do not want to use your other email? Well, in these cases, it is effortless to switch among the various added email accounts. Here’s how.

  1. While you are on the New Message screen, tap the default email address. It will expand. Tap once more.
  2. Choose another added email to switch to this one.
  3. This email will now be sent from the non-default account you choose.

Disable an email account on iOS device

  1. Open iPhone Settings and tap Mail.
  2. Tap Accounts.
  3. Tap the account you wish to disable.
  4. Toggle off Mail.
  5. Note: If you wish to turn off iCloud Mail, it requires two more steps. After step 3, tap iCloud and toggle off Mail.

Delete or remove an email account on iPhone and iPad

  1. Inside Settings, tap Mail.
  2. Tap Accounts.
  3. Choose the email account you wish to remove.
  4. Tap Delete Account and confirm.
  5. Note: If you want to remove the iCloud account, you will have to Sign Out of your Apple ID. Or, you may turn off the iCloud email from the preceding heading.

This is how you can set a default email account, switch among multiple emails while composing a new email, or disable and remove the ones you no longer need.

I hope this quick guide was helpful. If you have further related questions, please feel free to reach me via the comments section below.

  • 12 best email apps for iPhone and iPad
  • How to schedule emails on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  • How to email tracking pixel on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

title.rendered: TORRAS cases for iPhone 13: Versatile and value for money

content.rendered:
If you’re looking for a high-quality iPhone 13 series case that’s value for money, you may want to consider TORRAS. This brand offers a range of bumper cases in different varieties like transparent and kickstand ones. I was eager to try them out, and here’s my full review of TORRAS cases to give you honest insights into how they perform during everyday usage.

TORRAS cases for iPhone 13, 13 mini, 13 Pro, and 13 Pro Max 

TORRAS makes the same range of cases for the entire iPhone 13 lineup. They sent me five different cases for the iPhone 13 Pro, as listed below.

  1. Soft crystal clear TPU case
  2. Diamond hard-back clear case
  3. Guardian case with detachable buttons
  4. MoonClimber clear case with kickstand
  5. MarsClimber translucent case with kickstand

Let’s have a closer look at each case below. Please note that when I mention MagSafe compatibility, it only refers to MagSafe charging and not to MagSafe accessories like wallets or pop-sockets. None of these cases support magnetically attachable MagSafe accessories.

1. TORRAS crystal clear soft case

Key features

  • Flexible TPU material
  • 1.3 mm raised edges
  • MagSafe and Qi charging support
  • Sleek and lightweight

This soft clear case is designed to accentuate the beauty of your phone while offering essential protection. It feels incredibly smooth and supple in my hands and fits gorgeously around my iPhone 13 Pro. The high-quality transparency has a polished, reflective look that shows off the sleekness and original color of the phone.

Moreover, it’s sturdy enough to absorb minor shocks and falls. The 1.3mm raised edges guard the screen and camera against scratches when placed on flat surfaces.

It’s also compatible with MagSafe and Qi charging for ultimate convenience. You get a 180-day manufacturer’s warranty so that you can buy with confidence. It’s perfect if you prefer minimalist protection that helps you flaunt your phone.

Pros

  • Brilliant transparency enhances the look of your phone
  • Raised edges
  • Comfortable grip
  • Retains clarity over time

Cons

  • Will not protect against severe drops

Buy now: iPhone 13/13 Pro/13 Pro Max

2. TORRAS Guardian case

Key features

  • Military-grade drop protection
  • Reinforced shock-absorbing corners
  • Smooth, translucent finish
  • MagSafe and Qi charging support
  • Detachable buttons included with the case

This one’s my favorite of all the TORRAS cases because it’s minimalist, protective, and stylish all in one. I love the translucence finish and the super soft texture that’s still grippy enough.

Further, this case boasts military-grade drop protection and is sturdy enough to withstand life’s adventures. I wouldn’t worry about damaging my precious phone when out and about with this phone case as its guard.

But the best feature by far is detachable buttons. Yes, this case comes with two sets of neon-colored buttons that you can apply for a new look when you get bored of the default ones. The buttons are super easy to remove and detach, and they fit securely. They’re also easy to press to ensure usability.

Pros

  • Protective yet stylish
  • Military-grade drop protection
  • Detachable buttons
  • Excellent grip

Cons

  • The back attracts fingerprint smudges

Buy now: iPhone 13 /iPhone 13 Pro /iPhone 13 Pro Max

3. TORRAS MoonClimber clear case with kickstand

Key features

  • Qi and MagSafe charging
  • Slim and lightweight
  • Adjustable metal kickstand
  • Varied viewing angles up to 60 degrees
  • Drop-protection with reinforced corners

Want your phone case to have some extra functionality? A built-in kickstand can be pretty nifty to prop up your device for video calls, media consumption, and more. Well, the TORRAS MoonClimber is one of the best kickstand cases I’ve seen, with a super solid and stylish foldable metal stand.

It works to prop your phone both horizontally and vertically as per your convenience. Moreover, the kickstand is built with aluminum that utilizes unique shaft technology to offer a lifespan of over 20,000+ folds.

You also get all the advantages of a clear case, such as the chance to flaunt your device while protecting it from scratches, dust, and drops. It’s also lightweight and easy to hold for portability.

Pros

  • Military-grade drop protection
  • Shock-absorbing corners
  • Multi-angle kickstand
  • The kickstand is sturdy and durable

Cons

  • Feels a bit slippery

Buy now: iPhone 13

Verdict: Simple, but unique indeed

All five cases from TORRAS are impressive and attractive. I was spoilt for choice about which to use on my daily driver. Each one lives up to the brand’s tagline of being “simple, but unique.” To sum up, below are my overall impressions about the range of cases.

Design

Each case is beautifully designed to accentuate the original look of the iPhone 13 series devices. They’re lightweight yet protective, soft to touch yet grippy and stylish. Further, the buttons are easy to push, and the ports have precise cutters. The clear cases perfectly showcase the color of your device, and the kickstand cases are super convenient for hands-free usage.

Protection

TORRAS iPhone cases offer reliable drop-protection and are ideal for hassle-free everyday use. You won’t need to worry about the occasional fall or everyday wear and tear like scratches and scuffs.

Further, all cases have slightly raised edges around the screen and the camera bump to protect these delicate parts from rubbing against surfaces. Despite the heavy-duty protection, the cases look sleek and do not add bulk to your phone. So, it’s the best of both worlds.

User-friendliness

With support for both Qi and MagSafe charging, all TORRAS cases are perfect for your daily driver. The high-quality materials and precise finishing will ensure durability at an affordable price point. They’re some of the most value-for-money bumper cases you can get to protect your iPhone in style.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

title.rendered: How to make full-screen Siri on iPhone

content.rendered:
On iOS 14 and later, your favorite smart assistant Siri appears as a small circle at the bottom of the screen when invoked. But you can make Siri full-screen on your iPhone if you want. This was the norm on earlier versions of iOS. If you prefer the older full-screen interface, here’s how to get it on the latest iOS versions too. 

How to enable full-screen Siri on iPhone

  1. Open the Settings app.
  2. Tap on Accessibility.
  3. Tap on Siri.

  4. Disable Show Apps Behind Siri.

Now, press the Right side button or use Hey Siri. You will see that the assistant takes the full-screen and blurs the background.

How to disable Siri full-screen on iPhone

After you download and install the latest iOS, by default, Siri takes over the compact look. However, if you followed the above steps and changed it to full-screen mode, you can revert it back by enabling Show Apps Behind Siri.

That’s all!

Which function excites you the most? Please share it with us in the comments section below.

Read more:

  • How to teach Siri to pronounce names correctly on iPhone
  • How to make Siri wait longer to respond on iPhone

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.

title.rendered: How to use two-factor authentication on Mac

content.rendered:
Situations like data leaks, identity theft, account hacking, etc., are no more an anomaly. So user security measures like two-factor authentication (2FA) are a wise plan. Maybe that’s why Apple has jumped onto the wagon and integrated two-factor authentication in macOS, iOS, and iPadOS.

As part of Apple’s built-in password manager, iCloud Keychain, the 2FA feature has many benefits. But before we hop on to how to set up two-factor authentication in macOS, let’s first understand a bit more about it.

  • What is 2FA, and why should you use it on Mac?
  • How to set up two-factor authentication in Mac
  • Login using two-factor authentication on Mac
  • How to delete two-factor authentication on Mac

What is 2FA, and why should you use it on Mac?

Two-factor authentication is a verification code like OTPs used alongside passwords to add an extra layer of authenticity to your login process. Consider this as an extra set of locks that keeps malicious parties from accessing your accounts and data within them.

And maybe not for every account, but in today’s day and age, it is wise to secure your important and confidential accounts with two-factor authentication. You can generate the said code via password manager apps or external devices.

And now, with macOS Monterey or later, you can generate two-factor codes and login to websites, apps, and services using iCloud Keychain (Passwords feature).

Interestingly, the feature is synced across devices, and you can use codes from Mac on iPhone and vice-a-versa. Plus, if you use Safari, you won’t even have to copy-paste the code; autofill takes care of that.

How to set up two-factor authentication in macOS

I am using the Twitter web as an example to explain how to set up two-factor authentication in Mac. And while the overall premises remain the same, the method might vary a bit depending upon the website, app, or setting.

  1. Launch Twitter web, and go to the 2FA setting; it usually follows Settings → Security → Two-factor Authentication.
  2. Select the Authentication app from the available options and follow the on-screen instruction until you get the QR code.

  3. Quick setup – On the QR code window, secondary click or control + click the QR code, select Set Up Verification Code, and follow on-screen instructions. If this option isn’t available, check out the next step.
  4. Manual setup – Click Can’t Scan a QR Code and then copy the code that appears.

  5. Now, click the Apple logo from the top → System Preferences → Passwords → enter the device password.
  6. Search and select the website’s login or create a new login.
  7. Click Edit.

  8. Click Enter Setup Key, next to Verification Code.
  9. Paste the code here and click OK.

  10. Now a 30-second code generator will start; click Save to return to the main window.
  11. Copy the current code and go back to the website, and tap Next on the verification code window.
  12. Enter the six-digit code here and click Verify.
  13. Once verified, you’ll see a backup code; write it down in a safe place.

Note: Not all apps, websites, and services support two-factor authentication from Mac. For instance, as of writing, you can’t enable an authentication app for the Instagram web; the feature is limited to mobile devices.

Login using two-factor authentication on Mac

If you are using Safari, the iCloud Keychain app will auto-fill the verification code, quite like passwords, forms, and credit card details.

Note: If you have a Mac with Touch ID, scan your finger to auto-enter the code and enable two-factor authentication.

And if you are using any other browser, app, or service, you’ll have to manually fetch the code.

  1. Click the Apple logo → select System Preferences → Passwords.
  2. Enter your device password.
  3. Search and select the website/app/service login.
    You’ll see the 30-sec code on the details screen.
  4. Copy, paste the code to the desired location and proceed to log in.

How to delete two-factor authentication on Mac

Before we disable two-factor authentication on Mac, you should disable it from the website, app, or service from their Settings → Security → Two-factor Authentication section; this protects you from being locked out of your account.

  1. Go to System Preferences → Passwords and enter your device password.
  2. Search and select the login credentials.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Here, select Delete Verification Code.
  5. In the pop-up, click Delete Verification Code again to confirm the action.

And that’s how it is done!

While setting up the two-factor authentication code on mac is slightly tricky, it will make your login process much smoother and safer. Moreover, once you get the hang of it, the whole process will not take more than a minute.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can you change the MAC address on your iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes and no. While you may switch between public and private MAC IDs on your iPhone or iPad, you can't tweak their values by yourself as they're built-in to your device.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address the same as the Wi-Fi address?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Wi-Fi address is the same as the MAC address. But note that Bluetooth also has its MAC address. So it's also safe to say that the Wi-Fi address on your iPhone or iPad is a type of media access control ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. How do I find my Wi-Fi MAC address on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As explained, you can find your iPhone or iPad's MAC address by checking its About info in the Settings app.

mainEntity.name: Q. Can two devices have the same MAC address?

acceptedAnswer.text: The MAC address is unique to every device. So no two devices can share the same MAC address.

mainEntity.name: Q. How many MAC addresses can a device have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, a device has one MAC address for each network connection interface. In essence, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and ethernet each have a unique MAC ID.

mainEntity.name: Q. Is the MAC address similar to an IP address?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. While a MAC address remains the same, regardless of location or network you connect with, an IP address changes with network and geolocation. Plus, an IP is an internet protocol.
